feeding_claim.verbatim: They are pasture raised and grain finished.

resold_note: Also sells pork from a neighboring Daviess County farm, plus milk, cheese and other products from partner producers.
notes: Checked homepage, about, our products, online store, boxes and contact pages. Beef is pasture raised with grass or hay plus a daily grain ration and grain finished. Farm raises the beef, broilers and layers; pork comes from a neighboring farmer. Market store open Monday to Friday 10 to 6 and Saturday 9 to 3; cuts in store or at the Owensboro Farmers Market; call for pickup or shipping, no shipping area named. Many beef boxes showed out of stock.
